data.public_summary: Add deterministic pending-snapshot planning in brain_memory.py and a scheduled/dispatchable GitHub Actions workflow (.github/workflows/brain-memory-cron.yml) that validates workflows/memory/*.jsonl, packs changed/unsynced daily snapshots, and pushes archives + manifest sidecars to Google Drive Vault safely under PR-only main rulesets.

authority.objective: Wire automated daily GitHub Actions Brain Memory validate -> pack-snapshot -> push-snapshot cron cleanly on a dedicated feature branch
constraints: Keep PR bounded to approved scope; do not bypass Rulesets or alter governance files

invocation.objective: Implement plan_snapshot_sync in brain_memory.py, plan-sync CLI, .github/workflows/brain-memory-cron.yml, documentation, and regression tests

result.summary: Implemented initial plan_snapshot_sync, plan-sync CLI, .github/workflows/brain-memory-cron.yml, README update, and initial regression tests

evidence.summary: Initial cron & sync-planning implementation on feat/brain-memory-daily-cron prior to adversarial audit

checks.name: initial-rust-python-yaml-e2e-suite
checks.summary: 55/55 python unittests, 4 fake-rclone E2E scenarios, PyYAML check, 17/17 rust tests, and ruleset/admission checks passed prior to adversarial audit

evidence.summary: Local test and E2E suite passed on Attempt 1

findings.summary: HIGH-1: plan_snapshot_sync returns up_to_date on first matching manifest without authoritative_manifest_dir or cross-dir last_pushed_utc conflict detection, letting stale cache/Git manifests mask Drive deletions or newer conflicting pushes

MEDIUM-2..4: Missing RCLONE_ASK_PASSWORD=false & DEVNULL stdin in vault._default_runner; plan_snapshot_sync omits summary.json SHA/type strictness & vault.load_manifest str checks; LS_RC=3 can mask misconfigured root_folder_id without checking gdrive: root for Alpha_mining_Vault/ and skips Drive query in dry_run

instructions: Add authoritative_manifest_dir + cross-dir last_pushed_utc conflict detection in plan_snapshot_sync & --authoritative-manifest-dir in scripts/brain_memory.py and brain-memory-cron.yml

Harden non-interactive rclone execution (RCLONE_ASK_PASSWORD=false, </dev/null, DEVNULL stdin in _default_runner), verify gdrive: root Alpha_mining_Vault/ before treating state_snapshots rc=3 as bootstrap, query Drive manifests read-only in dry_run when configured, and add --max-depth 1

Harden load_manifest type/hex checks in vault.py, verify summary.json canonical SHA + strict entry checks in plan_snapshot_sync, move cron archives/drive_manifests to .vault_staging, catch UnicodeDecodeError in scripts/brain_memory.py, pass newline='\n', and expand tests for all findings

invocation.objective: Resolve all 1 High, 3 Medium, and 3 Low adversarial audit findings across vault.py, brain_memory.py, scripts/brain_memory.py, brain-memory-cron.yml, and test suites

result.summary: Resolved all Attempt 1 adversarial findings (HIGH-1, MEDIUM-2..4, LOW-5..7) across brain_memory.py, vault.py, scripts/brain_memory.py, brain-memory-cron.yml, README.md, and test suites

evidence.summary: Added authoritative_manifest_dir + nanosecond last_pushed_utc conflict ordering, non-interactive rclone & gdrive root Alpha_mining_Vault/ check, dry_run Drive read query, .vault_staging isolation, strict vault/manifest validation, and expanded tests
